extras: Pro features require a one-time purchase, not a subscription. The plugin works offline, but AI features require external API keys.
intentEvidence: I built Reading Vault because I wanted my books, my highlights and my notes in one place, as plain files I own.
motivation: I built Reading Vault because I wanted my books, my highlights and my notes in one place, as plain files I own. No separate app, no account, no hidden database: every book, highlight and saved word is an ordinary Markdown note in your vault.
problem: Users often keep their reading materials, highlights, and notes in separate applications, leading to fragmented knowledge and data ownership issues.
summary: A reader for EPUB and PDF books that allows users to manage a library, read content, and convert highlights into local Markdown notes within the Obsidian vault.
